message.content: Now let me verify the JSON is valid, complete, and uses only allowed vocabulary.

function.name: shell
function.arguments:
{"command": "python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, os, glob
allowed = {"off_by_one","mutable_default","shadowed_builtin","wrong_except","integer_division","unclosed_resource","silent_truncation","mutable_shared_state","missing_validation","wrong_default","sort_instability","resource_leak"}
d = json.load(open("findings.json"))
files = sorted(os.path.basename(p) for p in glob.glob("src/*.py"))
print("files:", files)
print("keys :", sorted(d))
print("all 12 present:", sorted(d)==files)
print("values all allowed:", all(v in allowed for v in d.values()))
print("values distinct:", len(set(d.values()))==len(d))
print("missing:", set(files)-set(d), "extra:", set(d)-set(files))
EOF"}

function.arguments: {"command": "cp findings.json /artifacts/findings.json 2>/dev/null && echo \"copied to /artifacts\" || echo \"no /artifacts write\"; cat findings.json"}
